news.title: Las Vegas businessman convicted in $24 million 'AI supercomputer' crypto Ponzi scheme
news.summary: Brent Kovar has been found guilty of running a crypto Ponzi scheme, defrauding at least 400 investors out of $24 million.

news.title: A 3% token move just triggered $36 million in Ethereum DeFi liquidations
news.summary: One wallet bought heavily into a yield token, which pushed the price of its paired principal token down just enough to trigger liquidations across borrowers using it as collateral.

news.title: MiCA revolutionised European crypto, and left Poland licking its wounds
news.summary: Many in Poland may look back at 2026 as the year European crypto finally grew up, and one of Poland’s brightest economic ambitions faded into darkness, writes Mateusz Kara, founder and CEO of Morphic

news.title: Crypto custody firm Copper has potential buyers. But offers are way below its $500 million asking price
news.summary: Once valued at $2.5 billion, Copper was being marketed by investment bank Cantor Fitzgerald at around $500 million in May this year.

news.title: LayerZero unveils trading infrastructure for crypto and tokenized markets, ZRO surges
news.summary: The trading infrastructure runs on LayerZero's Zero blockchain, backed by Citadel Securities with DTCC and ICE exploring institutional market applications.

news.title: U.S. state banking associations plan to launch their own nationwide blockchain network
news.summary: The "BankChain Alliance" is aiming for a 2027 launch, and would foster stablecoins, payments and tokenized deposits inside the banking system's regulatory sphere.
